speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) what measures are being put in place to deter and detect road touts; and (b) whether there have been any convictions for road touting in the last five years and, if so, how many.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: Just a follow-up supplementary question to the Minister of State.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: Based on a CNA article I read about one to two months ago, one of the interviewees said that this appears to be a very prevalent occurrence.

speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
text: I am just wondering what measures are put in place to detect road touts and also not just on the touts themselves, but on the workshops that facilitate some of these egregious claims.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: So, people are aware and our sense is that people know how to handle it, remain calm, they disengage.
